columns.definition: not used

columns.definition: The child sequence is used for caresets only, to allow an orderable to be added into a careset multiple times.

columns.name: EXT_OWNER_CD
columns.definition: Code that indicates from what entry in codeset 106 this bill item was contributed. 106 entry examples include General Lab, Radiology, etc.

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_CONTRIBUTOR_CD
columns.definition: Code that makes the parent reference id unique (in the case of multiple parent reference id sources)

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_ENTITY_NAME
columns.definition: Indicates whether the contributor for the parent was another bill item as in the case of specific as indicated by 'bill_item', or if it was an external contributor as indicated by 'code_value'. This is blank for default children.

columns.name: EXT_PARENT_REFERENCE_ID
columns.definition: The id used to cross reference external parent information to internal bill items during charging/pricing.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table CDI_FORM, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: A row in this table represents a CPDI interactive form and contains configuration information about the form.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: AUTO_PRINT_IND
columns.definition: Indicates that this form should be auto-printed upon completion.

columns.name: CDI_DOCUMENT_SUBTYPE_ID
columns.definition: Foreign key to cdi_document_subtype table. Optionally identifies a document subtype.

columns.name: CDI_FORM_ID
columns.definition: The unique primary key of this table. It is an internally generated number.

columns.name: EVENT_CD
columns.definition: Event code that corresponds to the CPDI document type. Can be multiple code sets; associated code set is stored in column event_code_set.

columns.name: EVENT_CODE_SET
columns.definition: Specifies the code set for the event_cd field.

columns.name: FORM_DESCRIPTION
columns.definition: Patient-friendly description of the form.

columns.name: FORM_NAME
columns.definition: Displays the name of the CDI Form.

columns.name: LOGICAL_DOMAIN_ID
columns.definition: The unique identifier for a logical domain. This identifier allows the data to be grouped by logical domain. For example, If you assign clients a logical_domain_id this would allow you to store data for multiple clients on this table.

columns.name: MEDIA_OBJECT_IDENT
columns.definition: Foreign key to dms_media_identifier, if form is stored in media object management.

columns.name: PAGE_CNT
columns.definition: Number of pages in this form if this form is static; 0 if unknown or if the form is dynamic.

columns.name: PROCEDURAL_FORM_IND
columns.definition: Indicates whether the form is a non-registration form. 0 - No, 1 - Yes

columns.name: SIGNATURE_PAGE_IND
columns.definition: indicates whether or not this document is being used as a signature page.

columns.name: SOURCE_FORM_IDENT
columns.definition: Unique form identifier in source system.

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: ADMIN_DOSAGE
columns.definition: Actual volume or quantity of administration.

columns.name: ADMIN_END_DT_TM
columns.definition: For continuous administrations, this field is the end of the time period in which this administration was active. If the administration is currently active, this field will be NULL. For intermittent administrations, this field does not apply.

columns.definition: Time zone associated with the corresponding DT_TM column.

columns.definition: The method of the administration. i.e. chew, shampoo.

columns.name: ADMIN_NOTE
columns.definition: Short note associated with this medication administration

columns.definition: Personnel ID of provider administering medication.

columns.name: ADMIN_PT_LOC_CD
columns.definition: The patient location when the medication was administered.

columns.name: ADMIN_ROUTE_CD
columns.definition: Route of administration. i.e. PO, TOP, IM.

columns.name: ADMIN_SITE_CD
columns.definition: For certain administration routes a body site might be needed to fully describe the method of administration. i.e. IM-Right Arm.

columns.name: ADMIN_START_DT_TM
columns.definition: The time at which this medication administration became active for continuous administrations. For intermittent, it is the time the administration happened.

columns.name: ADMIN_START_TZ
columns.definition: Time zone associated with the corresponding DT_TM column.

columns.name: ADMIN_STRENGTH
columns.definition: Use when medication_product_cd does not specify the strength.

columns.name: ADMIN_STRENGTH_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: Units for admin_strength. This may be a compound unit (i.e. ml/hr).

columns.name: BOLUS_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Bolus (an amount of IV medication administered rapidly to decrease the response time or to be used as a loading dose prior to an infusion) type. i.e. PCA, Loading.

columns.name: DILUENT_TYPE_CD

columns.name: DOSAGE_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: Unit of measurement for dosage. i.e. tablet, ml.

columns.name: INFUSED_VOLUME
columns.definition: The volume at any one point in time that remains in the IV Bag.

columns.name: INFUSED_VOLUME_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: Unit of measure for infused volume

columns.definition: Value from 13016 that represents "ORD ID".

columns.definition: TASK_ID from the order.

columns.definition: The master event id contains the cs_order_id for caresets or the order_id for regular orderables. This ties back to the order table.

columns.definition: Value from 13016 that represents "ORD CAT".

columns.name: EXT_M_REFERENCE_ID
columns.definition: ID from the order catalog for the ordered item.

columns.definition: This column specifies where the charge modification came from: upstream, reference build or modified manually.

columns.name: FIELD1
columns.definition: No longer used. Depending on the value in charge_mod_type_cd, this is either the value from 13030 that represents the suspense reason, or it is the value from 14002 that represents the bill code schedule.

columns.name: FIELD10
columns.definition: not used

columns.name: FIELD1_ID

columns.definition: Event code associated with the text rendered from the form.

columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table. The UPDT family of columns are typically used for housekeeping and external system process and should never be depended on for solution specific logic.

columns.name: WIDTH
columns.definition: Width the form should be sized

response.definition: Encounter level DRG informantion such as weight, desc...

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: ALOS
columns.definition: This is the alos assigned for this DRG

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CASE_RESOURCE_WEIGHT
columns.definition: This is the assigned case resource weight

columns.name: COMPLEXITY_OVERLAY
columns.definition: This is the assigned complexity overlay assigned to this DRG

columns.name: COMPLEXITY_OVERLAY_TEXT
columns.definition: This is the text that was assigned by the encoder and passed into Cerner systems.

columns.name: DAY_THRESHOLD
columns.definition: This is the day threshold that was assigned by the encoder and passed into Cerner systems.

columns.name: DRG_ENCNTR_EXTENSION_ID
columns.definition: This is the unique identifier for the DRG encounter extension table, it is a system assigned number.

columns.name: DRG_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the DRG table.

columns.name: DRG_SPECIALTY_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the drg_specialty table.

columns.name: DRG_WEIGHT
columns.definition: Stores the DRG weight for groupers whose weights are not stored in the drg_extension table. Null = Look for the weight in the drg_extension table -1 = Blank Values >= 0 are valid weights.

columns.name: ELOS
columns.definition: This is the estimated length of stay that was assigned by the encoder and passed into Cerner systems.

columns.name: ENCNTR_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_SLICE_ID
columns.definition: Identifies an Encounter as it relates to a time slice.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: EPISODE_CLINICAL_COMPLEX_SCORE
columns.definition: The ECCS is the measure of the cumulative effect of Diagnosis Complexity Level for a specific episode. Episode Clinical Complexity Score (ECCS), which replaces PCCL in AR-DRG v 8.0 and used for reimbursement calculation.

columns.name: HIGH_TRIM_VALUE
columns.definition: A figure representing the high trim point of the WIES calculation.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: END_LEAVE_USER_ID
columns.definition: User who documented that the patient's leave of absence has ended.

columns.name: EST_RETURN_DT_TM

columns.definition: Date and time the room and bed will be removed if patient is still on leave of absence.

columns.name: LEAVE_COMMENT
columns.definition: Free-text comment describing any notes or information relating to the encounter leave.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table ENCNTR_LOC_HIST, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: Contains the history of location, encntr type, med service, and alt level of care changes for a specific encounter. This can be used for processes requiring patient encounter tracking information, for example, infection control.

columns.name: ACCOMMODATION_CD
columns.definition: Current type of accommodations in which the patient (encounter) has been placed. (e.g. Private, Semi Private, etc.)

columns.name: ACCOMMODATION_REASON_CD
columns.definition: Describes why the accommodation the patient received was given. (e.g. Doctor requested, patient requested)

columns.name: ACCOMMODATION_REQUEST_CD
columns.definition: Describes the accommodation that was requested, either by the patient or a staff member. This value may differ from the actual accommodation that the patient/encounter was given. For example, the patient may request a private room, but only receive a semi-private room because no

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_DT_TM
columns.definition: This column holds the current date and time of the system that the row was inserted

columns.name: ADMIT_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Admit type indicates the circumstance under which the patient was admitted or will be admitted. (i.e., accident, emergent, routine, elective, labor/delivery, etc.)

columns.name: ALC_DECOMP_DT_TM
columns.definition: Date and time the alternate level of care decompensation

columns.name: ALC_REASON_CD
columns.definition: Reason the alternate level of care is being assigned or changed

columns.name: ALT_LVL_CARE_CD
columns.definition: Level of care for the encounter at the time the history row is written, that signals a difference, or alternative, to the care signified by the encntr_type, med service, location, or combination therein. Used primarily as a billing function to trigger a change in charging rates.

columns.name: ALT_LVL_CARE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the alternate level of care was assigned

columns.name: ARRIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The actual date/time that the patient arrived at the facility. At the time of registration, if this field is null then it should be valued with the reg_dt_tm. Otherwise, the actual arrival date/time is captured.

columns.name: ARRIVE_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the arrive_dt_tm.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CHANGE_BIT
columns.definition: Identifies which columns have had a change.

columns.name: CHART_COMMENT_IND
columns.definition: FUTURE USE.

columns.name: COMMENT_TEXT
columns.definition: Textual column used to store free text information about the transaction which triggered the history row. For example, through a location transfer transaction, a description of the transfer can be captured.

columns.name: DEPART_DT_TM
columns.definition: The actual date/time that the patient left from the facility. In many cases, this field may be null unless the user process requires capturing this data.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table ENCNTR_PERSON_RELTN, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: The encounter-person relationship table contains pointers to related persons in the person table .The kind of relationship (i.e., accompanied by, accident witness, etc.) and genetic indication defines how the encounter and person are related.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CONTACT_ROLE_CD
columns.definition: This field is equivalent to the HL7 contact role field in the Next of Kin segment. This field is generally not used by the Cerner system, since there are other preferred ways to store data indicated by this HL7 field.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: COPY_CORRESPONDENCE_CD
columns.definition: Denotes whether the related person should be copied on any correspondence to the person.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Data status indicates a level of authenticity of the row data. Typically this will either be AUTHENTICATED or UNAUTHENTICATED.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the data_status_cd was set.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the data_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: DEFAULT_RELTN_IND
columns.definition: Identifies whether the relationship is the default displayable Mother-Child relationship.

columns.name: ENCNTR_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_PERSON_RELTN_ID
columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter person relationship table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: FAMILY_RELTN_SUB_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The specific family relationship

columns.name: FREE_TEXT_CD
columns.definition: Describes the type of free text information that is available for the person. When set to a meaning of 'FTBRIEF', this indicates that the related_person_id is NULL, meaning that there is no reference to the person table.

columns.name: FT_REL_PERSON_NAME
columns.definition: The name of the person in the 'free text' relationship indicated by the free_text_ind in the row being set to 'TRUE'.

columns.name: GENETIC_RELATIONSHIP_IND
columns.definition: Indicates whether the relationship is genetic.

columns.name: INTERNAL_SEQ
columns.definition: Sequence used within Cerner applications to order encounter person relationship rows.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table ENCNTR_PLAN_RELTN, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: The encounter-health plan relation table contains pointers to health plans for a specific encounter. This table is similar to the person health plan relation table, except that the health plans relate to a specific encounter.

columns.name: ACCEPT_ASSIGNMENT_CD
columns.definition: Provider acceptance for payment terms.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: ALT_MEMBER_NBR
columns.definition: The alternate payer plan member number for the person.

columns.name: ASSIGN_BENEFITS_CD
columns.definition: Codified column representing the nature/status of benefit assignment for the use of the health plan on this encounter.

columns.name: AUTH_REQUIRED_CD
columns.definition: Documents whether or not authorization is required for given encounter health plan relation

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Status/Type of the billing balance for this encounter and this health plan.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_TZ
columns.definition: The time zone associated with the beg_effective_dt_tm column.

columns.name: BENEFIT_VERIFY_DT_TM
columns.definition: The data and time at which the health plan benefits were last verified.

columns.name: CARD_CATEGORY_CD
columns.definition: A categorization of the coverages and/or benefits available to the recipient. For some insurances this may be clearly identifiable based on characteristics of the beneficiary's coverage card.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUE_NBR
columns.definition: The card issue number is used to track the number of cards dispensed. The original card is typically issue number 00, with subsequent cards incremented.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: COORD_BENEFITS_CD
columns.definition: Codified value representing the coordination of benefits for this health plan for this encounter.

columns.name: COVERAGE_COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID
columns.definition: An identifier that points to a row in the LONG_TEXT table where comments about the plan coverage are stored.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Data status indicates a level of authenticity of the row data. Typically this will either be AUTHENTICATED or UNAUTHENTICATED.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the data_status_cd was set.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the data_status_cd to be set or change.

response.definition: The encounter-personnel relationship table contains pointers to related personnel in the personnel table. The kind of relationship (i.e., admitting physician, attending, etc.) defines how the encounter and personnel are related.

columns.definition: This is the value of the unique primary identifier of the encounter table. It is an internal system assigned number.

columns.name: ENCNTR_TYPE_CD

columns.definition: Indicates whether the relationship between the encounter and the personnel has expired.

columns.name: EXPIRE_DT_TM
columns.definition: Date/Time that the relationship has been expired from encounter. Primarily used to prevent the relationship from appearing in PowerChart application.

columns.name: FT_PRSNL_NAME
columns.definition: The name of the personnel in the 'free text' relationship indicated by the free_text_ind in the row being set to 'TRUE'.

columns.name: INTERNAL_SEQ
columns.definition: Used within Cerner applications, if necessary, to order encounter personnel relation rows.

columns.name: ADMIT_WITH_MEDICATION_CD

columns.definition: Date and time the alternate level of care decompensation

columns.name: ALC_REASON_CD
columns.definition: Reason the alternate level of care is being assigned or changed

columns.definition: Level of care for the encounter that signals a difference, or alternative, to the care signified by the encntr_type, med service, location, or combination therein. Used primarily as a billing function to trigger a change in charging rates.

columns.definition: the date the recommendation is due

columns.definition: A free text description of the expectation associated with this recommendation

columns.definition: the code value of the overridden expectation name

columns.definition: Expectation ID from HM_EXPECT

columns.name: FREQUENCY_UNIT_CD
columns.definition: The unit that is associated with the frequency.

columns.name: FREQUENCY_VAL
columns.definition: The frequency between when this person should be recommended for this expectation.

columns.name: LAST_SATISFACTION_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that this recommendation was last satisfied.

columns.name: LAST_SATISFACTION_ID
columns.definition: The actual id of the activity data that last "satisfied" the recommendation. The source of this value is shown in satisfaction_source field.

columns.name: LAST_SATISFACTION_SOURCE
columns.definition: Source of the value of the last_satisfaction_id

columns.name: LAST_SATISFIED_BY_ID
columns.definition: The person who last satisfied this recommendation.

columns.name: NEAR_DUE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time this recommendation becomes near due.

columns.name: OVERDUE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time this recommendation becomes overdue

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.definition: Patient Person_id

columns.name: QUALIFIED_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time on which the person qualified for the recommendation.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_ID
columns.definition: Primary Key

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table LOCATION, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: The location table is a reference of all locations in the system. Examples of some types of locations include facility (institution), building, nurse unit, room bed, outpatient, inventory, lab, pharmacy, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: APACHE_RELTN_FLAG
columns.definition: Defines a relationship to be considered by Cerner Apache integrated Risk Adjustment software.0 - No defined relationship to Cerner Apache integrated Risk Adjustment software, 1 - Temporary procedural location used by Cerner Apache integrated Risk Adjustment software. A temporary

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CENSUS_IND
columns.definition: Set to TRUE, if this location is be included on the patient census report. Otherwise, set to FALSE.

columns.name: CHART_FORMAT_ID
columns.definition: Temporary mechanism to denote the chart format to be used for expedites when results should print at the location's printer

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SOURCE_CD
columns.definition: The code value for the contributing system

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Data status indicates a level of authenticity of the row data. Typically this will either be AUTHENTICATED or UNAUTHENTICATED.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the data_status_cd was set.

columns.name: DATA_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the data_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: DISCIPLINE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Used with Service Area locations. Indicates the discipline (lab, rad, etc.) of the service area.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: EXP_LVL_CD
columns.definition: Temporary means to indicate when the expedite should be triggered (i.e., upon any result verification or only when the order is complete).

columns.name: FACILITY_ACCN_PREFIX_CD
columns.definition: Used on facility location rows. Indicates the accession prefix (site prefix).

columns.name: ICU_IND
columns.definition: Indicates if this location should be considered an ICU location if/when the Cerner Apache integrated Risk Adjustment software is being used.

columns.name: LOCATION_CD
columns.definition: The field identifies the current permanent location of the patient. The location for an inpatient will be valued with the lowest level location type in the hierarchy of facility, building, nurse unit, room, bed.

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Location type defines the kind of location (I.e., nurse unit, room, inventory location, etc.). Location types have Cerner defined meanings in the common data foundation.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table LOCATION_GROUP, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: The location group table information about the hierachial relationship between different locations.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.name: CHILD_LOC_CD
columns.definition: This field is the location code which is the child in a relationship. If the relationship is facility to building, facility is the parent, building is child.

columns.name: END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date/time after which the row is no longer valid as active current data. This may be valued with the date that the row became inactive.

columns.name: LOCATION_GROUP_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The location group type identifies the kind of location associated with the parent location. Location group type codes have Cerner defined meanings in the common data foundation.

columns.name: PARENT_LOC_CD
columns.definition: This field is the location code which is the parent in a relationship. If the relationship is facility to building, facility is the parent, building is child.

columns.name: ROOT_LOC_CD
columns.definition: References the location code that is the highest level in a view's hierarchy. For patient care locations, the root code is 0.

columns.name: SEQUENCE
columns.definition: The relative position of the child location. Controls the order in which the child location displays relative to other children locations.

columns.name: UPDT_APPLCTX
columns.definition: The application context number from the record info block.

columns.name: UPDT_CNT
columns.definition: Set to 0 on insert. Incremented by 1 on update. Used to recognize update conflict where data in a row updated by one application is at risk of being lost by a second application attempting to update the row.

columns.name: UPDT_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the row was last inserted or updated.

columns.name: UPDT_ID
columns.definition: The person_id of the person from the personnel table (prsnl) that caused the last insert or update of the row in the table.

columns.name: UPDT_TASK
columns.definition: The registered (assigned) task number for the process that inserted or updated the row.

columns.name: VIEW_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: Precursor to root_location_cd. Needed for a conversion utility "LOC_CONVERT_VIEW_TYPES". No longer needed after the utility is performed. NO LONGER USED PROGRAMATICALLY

columns.definition: Indicates whether the ingredient was added to the ORDER by a USER, or by the SYSTEM to satisfy an order requirement or as part of an auto assign process.

columns.name: INGREDIENT_TYPE_FLAG
columns.definition: This shows what type of ingredient it is.

columns.name: IV_SEQ
columns.definition: The IV sequence for this ingredient.

columns.definition: This field includes the date and time the case was accessioned.

columns.name: ACCESSION_NBR
columns.definition: This field includes the case number assigned to the pathology case.

columns.name: ACCESSION_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: This field contains the internal identification code associated with the user who accessioned the case (the user who caused the row to be added to the PATHOLOGY_CASE table. This value could be used to join to information on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.definition: This field is not used at this time.

columns.definition: This column indicates whether or not there is any additional blob data associated with this case row (i.e. case images).

columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the identification code associated with the cancellation reason.

columns.name: CANCEL_DT_TM
columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the date and time the cancellation event occurred.

columns.name: CANCEL_ID
columns.definition: If the case is cancelled, this field contains the internal identification code of the user who executed the cancellation event. This value could be used to join to user information stored on the PRSNL and PERSON tables.

columns.name: CASE_COLLECT_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field includes the collection date and time associated with the case. Note that collection date and time information specific to the specimen(s) submitted for the case is stored on the CASE_SPECIMEN table.

columns.name: CASE_ID
columns.definition: This field uniquely identifies a row included on the PATHOLOGY_CASE table. CASE_ID is derived from ACCESSION.ACCESSION_

columns.name: CASE_NUMBER
columns.definition: This field includes the sequential number portion of the case (accession) number. The entire number is stored in the ACCESSION_NBR field.

columns.name: CASE_RECEIVED_DT_TM
columns.definition: This field includes the received date and time associated with the case. Note that the received date and time information specific to the specimen(s) submitted for the case is stored on the CASE_SPECIMEN table.

columns.name: CASE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: This field includes the identification code associated with the case type value. The case type is used to generically categorize the case based on the accession prefix value. Examples of case types include surgical, gyn, non-gyn, and autopsy.

columns.name: CASE_YEAR
columns.definition: This field includes the year portion of the case (accession) number. The entire number is stored in the ACCESSION_NBR field.

columns.name: CHR_IND
columns.definition: This indicator value specifies, for a pathology case, whether or not the patient was flagged as being at "clinical high risk (CHR)" for developing cervical cancer. columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.definition: This field is no longer used. Refer to the COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID for information regarding the pathology case comment.

columns.name: COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID
columns.definition: This field contains the value representing the entry on the LONG_TEXT table that contains the pathology case comment.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: DATASET_UID
columns.definition: This field contains the dataset UID string that will be assigned for this case. Each DICOM image that is attached to this case will use this dataset UID string.

columns.name: ALT_MEMBER_NBR
columns.definition: The alternate payer plan member number for the person.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time at which the patient health plan relationship (coverage) was archived. Once the coverage is archived, it should not be allocated to future encounters.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The id of the personnel who archived the patient health plan relationship (coverage)

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The type of balance.

columns.name: BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time for which this table row becomes effective. Normally, this will be the date and time the row is added, but could be a past or future date and time.

columns.definition: The time zone associated with the beg_effective_dt_tm column.

columns.name: CARD_CATEGORY_CD
columns.definition: A categorization of the coverages and/or benefits available to the recipient. For some insurances this may be clearly identifiable based on characteristics of the beneficiary's coverage card.

columns.name: CARD_ISSUE_NBR
columns.definition: The card issue number is used to track the number of cards dispensed. The original card is typically issue number 00, with subsequent cards incremented.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CODE
columns.definition: Identifies a contract between a facility and a person's related health plan.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: COVERAGE_COMMENTS_LONG_TEXT_ID
columns.definition: An identifier that points to a row in the LONG_TEXT table where comments about the plan coverage are stored.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The code value for the type of coverage of the plan.

columns.name: DEDUCT_AMT
columns.definition: The amount of the deductable for the plan.

columns.name: DEDUCT_MET_AMT
columns.definition: How much of the deductable has been met.

columns.name: DEDUCT_MET_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time the deductable was met.

columns.name: DENIAL_REASON_CD
columns.definition: The code value for the reason the claim was denied.

columns.definition: The Rad_Report_Id uniquely identifies a row in the Rad_Report table. It serves no other purpose other than to uniquely identify the row.

instruction: Describe the Cerner Millennium V500 table TASK_ACTIVITY, its primary keys, HealtheIntent ODS v1 availability, and its typed columns.

response.definition: Holds the values of the fields for a specific task created from the order server.

columns.name: ACTIVE_IND
columns.definition: The table row is active or inactive. A row is generally active unless it is in an inactive state such as logically deleted, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_CD
columns.definition: Indicates the status of the row itself (not the data in the row) such as active, inactive, combined away, pending purge, etc.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_DT_TM
columns.definition: The date and time that the active_status_cd was set.

columns.name: ACTIVE_STATUS_PRSNL_ID
columns.definition: The person who caused the active_status_cd to be set or change.

columns.name: BROADCAST_MESSAGE_UUID
columns.definition: Identifier associated to a broadcast message. This identifier would be used by message center messaging to roll up display of a broadcast message to a single item instead of seeing multiple same messages per patient recipient of the broadcast message.

columns.name: CALLER_CONTACT_TXT
columns.definition: A free text field used in message center messaging to contain the contact information for the caller of an office message. Usually the phone number but may contain the best method to reach the patient such as by text message or patient's email.

columns.name: CALLER_NAME
columns.definition: A free text field used in message center messaging to contain the name of the caller for a phone message. Usually a patient but may also be a patient's proxy (guardian / parent / advocate).

columns.name: CARESET_ID
columns.definition: The id of the associated CareSet.

columns.name: CATALOG_CD
columns.definition: The catalog_code of the order that is related to the specified task.

columns.name: CATALOG_TYPE_CD
columns.definition: The catalog_type_cd from the orders table.

columns.name: CHARTED_BY_AGENT_CD
columns.definition: Code value for the charting agent that is used to chart the task. Code set 255090

columns.name: CHARTED_BY_AGENT_IDENTIFIER
columns.definition: The reference string to identify which form or template is used when the task is charted.

columns.name: CHARTING_CONTEXT_REFERENCE
columns.definition: A reference string that is supplied by a charting agent at the time of initial documentation of a task. The charting agent may specify any string necessary to be stored such that combined with the charted_by_agent_identifier the charting agent can redisplay and modify the origina

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.definition: Stores the comments for documents displayed in the Inbox. This also stores the caller name and phone number for phone messages displayed in the inbox.

columns.name: CONFIDENTIAL_IND
columns.definition: An indicator to identify whether the task is confidential.

columns.name: CONTAINER_ID
columns.definition: Identifies the specimen container associated with the task.

columns.name: CONTINUOUS_IND
columns.definition: An indicator to identify whether this task is part of a continuous order.

columns.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SYSTEM_CD
columns.definition: Contributor system identifies the source feed of data from which a row was populated. This is mainly used to determine how to update a set of data that may have originated from more than one source feed.

columns.name: CONVERSATION_ID
columns.definition: The task_id of the initial task in a conversation thread.

instruction: Describe the Oracle Health Semantic Object Model (SOM) entity MedicationRequest and its key EHI fields.

response.description:
An order or request for both supply of the medication and the instructions for administration of the medication to a patient. This resource covers all type of orders for medications for a patient. This includes inpatient medication orders as well as community orders (whether filled by the prescriber or by a pharmacy). It also includes orders for over-the-counter medications (e.g. Aspirin), total parenteral nutrition and diet/ vitamin supplements. It may be used to support the order of medication-related devices e.g., prefilled syringes such as patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) syringes, or syringes used to administer other types of medications. e.g., insulin, narcotics.

This resource would not be used when ordering a device(s) that may have a medication coating e.g. heparin coated stints, or similar types of devices. It is not intended for use in prescribing particular diets, or for ordering non-medication-related items (eyeglasses, supplies, etc.). In addition, the MedicationRequest may be used to report orders/request from external systems that have been reported for informational purposes and are not authoritative and are not expected to be acted upon (e.g. dispensed or administered). The MedicationRequest resource allows requesting only a single medication.

instruction: Describe the Oracle Health HealtheIntent 'wellness-campaign-analytics_v1' feed schema, its overview, table count (19 tables), and its primary fact/dimension tables.

response.overview: The Wellness Campaign Analytics bundle contains data about wellness campaigns for a tenant.

files_summary.description: This table contains the version records of a campaign. These version records are also known as instances or configurations. A wellness campaign is an incentive program designed to motivate members to improve their health by completing incentivized activities. A campaign is an organized collection of incentivized activities grouped into categories, subcategories, and groups. A category can have subcategories and a subcategory can have groups. A campaign instance is generated using all the configuration data.
This table contains category definitions across all instances of wellness campaigns.
This table contains all the campaign-to-consumer mappings that were deleted.
This table contains the campaign-to-consumer mappings.
This table contains the details of all populations across all instances of wellness campaigns.

Participation in a wellness campaign is incentivized through rewards (also known as points). This table contains the details of adjustment rewards across all instances of wellness campaigns and their categories.

Wellness campaigns define objectives (also known as goals) for a consumer to complete to make them eligible for earning rewards. This table contains the details of all the alternative objectives across all instances of wellness campaigns and their categories.
Primary objectives (also known as goals) for categories in wellness campaigns have incentives. This table contains the details of the incentives associated with primary objectives.
This table contains all reward-to-consumer mappings. Rewards are also known as points.

Wellness campaigns define objectives (also known as goals) for a consumer to complete to make them eligible for earning rewards. This table contains the details of all the primary objectives across all instances of wellness campaigns and their categories.

Participation in a wellness campaign is incentivized through rewards (also known as points). This table contains the details of rewards across all instances of wellness campaigns and their categories.
Objectives (also known as goals) can have exemptions defined for them. This table contains details of exemptions awarded to consumers across all instances of wellness campaigns.
This table contains details to support consumer objectives (also known as goals) across all instances of wellness campaigns.
This table contains all instances of consumers' fulfillment of objectives (also known as goals).
This table contains all instance of consumers' incentives.
